wiki_text: The GNL del Plata FSRU (also Montevideo LNG Terminal), a planned floating storage and regasification unit with a protective breakwater at Punta Sayago near Montevideo, was developed by Gas Sayago S.A., a joint venture of Uruguay's state electricity utility UTE and state oil company ANCAP. After the GDF Suez (Engie)-led EPC and FSRU arrangements collapsed in 2015 the project stalled and has seen no development activity since; Gas Sayago S.A. is registered as 'En Liquidacion' (in liquidation). The terminal is treated as cancelled.
